text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: Congratulations on placing in the top five.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, why thank you very much for your courtesy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, making the board is great and all, but...
I dunno, it kinda feels like fate playing tricks on me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't a magnificent 1st place,
nor a 2nd place where struggling just a little harder might have...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, a solid 3rd place.
How do I put it... it just feels so typical of me.
choice_data_list: Still, there's no doubt that's a wonderful result.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know.
Still, it makes me happy, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it proves that I'm doing
pretty well for myself right now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, thinking about what lies ahead...
I've gotta step it up a notch, no, two notches higher.
choice_data_list: Next time, a solid 1st place is definitely within reach!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, that's way too conservative!
Do you even know what 'playing it safe' means?!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "First, treating me to some Edomae sushi to celebrate 3rd place—that's a Trainer's job, isn't it?"
choice_data_list: Then if you get 1st place, high-end sushi it is!
Then if you get 1st place, high-end sushi it is!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Then 1st place... No, that's asking for way too much!
Buuut...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez!
Luring me with sushi is totally unfair~!
